decision: DeepSeek-V4-Flash stays as the reply model (2026-08-20). Qwen 3.8-27B won the aggregate 18-9 with 19 ties, and the aggregate misled: its wins were 8-0 in grounding, while DeepSeek took the comparison/trade-off and decisiveness shapes that match how this assistant is actually used - confirmed on a real conceptual question the user preferred DeepSeek's answer to. Speed sealed it: every Qwen quantisation that runs on this hardware decodes at 4.6-8.2 tok/s against DeepSeek's 22.1, and a live UI trial of the fastest was rejected as far too slow. Revisit when a container ships working MTP for GB10, or when a second DGX Spark lets both run at once - then Qwen takes the schema-bound callers and the empty vision-escalation slot with nothing traded away.
